topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Well, now, that’s a fine turn of events, isn’t it? Old Tom wants to put up a fence, does he? Just the other day, I was thinking how the sheep do get a bit too fond of wanderin’ into his plot. A fence might keep the critters from runnin’ wild and ruing his carrots. I reckon it’s a good day when a man decides to fix what’s his. Keeps the soil to its rightful place and the neighbors on good terms. I’ll lend him a hand if he needs it. After all, a well-set fence is a sight for the eyes and a comfort to the heart.
